# The Block File, Complete {#sec-block-file}

The running example of Part I and @sec-reading-the-block, exactly as written by Open CASCADE Technology 7.9 with parameter curves suppressed, apart from the product id and name, and the file name, author and organisation fields in the header.
One hundred and seventy records.
Open CASCADE wraps long records at commas to keep lines within 72 columns, except in the header, where the `FILE_NAME` strings leave it no break point.
